DIRECTION — "Move-out season"

Orange means one thing only: time running out. It appears on countdowns, clearance and the sell-fast price, nowhere else. Everything else is near-black + warm off-white.

Type: Bricolage Grotesque (display) / Instrument Sans (body). Graph-paper grid = campus notebook. Item art is line-drawn, not stock photos.
INTERACTIVE — click the category chips, they really filter the grid. Cards lift and the line art tilts on hover.

INTERACTIVE — drag the move-out slider.

This runs the REAL formula from src/lib/pricing/rails.ts, not a fake. Watch the panel go from off-white to amber to orange as the date closes in, and open "How we got this number" to see the multipliers.
Mobile comes later — this is here to show the system survives the squeeze. Same tokens, two-up grid, bottom nav.
